TR: Eline sağlık usta, tam kıvamında olmuş.
EN: Perfect as always, chef.

TR: Vallahi mahallenin en iyisi, helal olsun.
EN: Best in the neighbourhood, hands down.
Exactly what I wanted — keep the change.
That was good, thanks.
Not bad at all, see you soon.
Solid work, chef.
It's okay — could've used more care.
Fine, but nothing special.

TR: Ortalama, bir dahakine daha iyi olsun.
EN: Average. Do better next time.
That one missed the mark.
Honestly, not what I expected.
Hmm. That soured my mood a bit.
What is this? I want a refund!
I'm never setting foot in here again.
Terrible. I did not like this at all.

TR: Şu tezgâhın hâli ne böyle, iğrenç.
EN: Look at the state of that counter. Disgusting.
Might want to wash your hands, chef.
This place is filthy. I'm reporting it.

TR: Her zamanki gibi, sen bilirsin zaten.
EN: The usual — you already know.
This is exactly why I keep coming back.
I didn't expect this from you, chef.

TR: Bu fiyata bu mu, pahalı geldi.
EN: This much for that? Bit steep.
Keep the change, that was lovely.

TR: Bir saat bekledim, bu da mı olsun.
EN: I waited forever, and then this?
Took you ages. Kind of ruined it.

TR: Not aldım, bu dükkân iyi puan alacak.
EN: Noted. This place is getting a good score.

TR: Sipariş tam tutmadı ama yine de güzeldi.
EN: Not quite what I ordered, but it was good anyway.
Not what I asked for. It'll do, I suppose.
This isn't what I ordered, chef.

TR: Siparişi bir daha dinlesen iyi olur.
EN: You might want to listen to the order again.
I think you mixed it up — I asked for something else.
None of what I asked for is in this.

TR: Yanlış geldi, bir daha bakar mısın?
EN: This is wrong. Can you check it again?

TR: İki dakika önce söyledim, yine olmadı.
EN: I told you two minutes ago, and it's still wrong.
You've done the exact opposite of what I asked!

TR: Yanlış sipariş, üstüne bir de bu hâlde.
EN: Wrong order, and in this state on top of it.

TR: Yıllardır aynı şeyi söylüyorum usta, yine karıştı.
EN: I've ordered the same thing for years, chef, and it's still wrong.

TR: Acısını söylemiştim ama, bu o değil.
EN: I told you how hot I wanted it. This isn't it.

TR: Hem yanlış hem de şu tezgâhın hâli ortada.
EN: Wrong order, and look at the state of that counter.
